authority_order: vehicle handoff as consulting evidence only

status_definitions.implemented: Code and current runtime evidence support the requirement within its stated scope.
status_definitions.partial: Some implementation exists, but the end-to-end behavior or cloud connection is incomplete.
status_definitions.blocked: Prepared work cannot proceed without a genuine policy, account-holder, financial, or exact-artifact decision.
status_definitions.missing: No adequate executable implementation was found.

requirements.requirement: Operate as a reusable domain intelligence engine, with SmartGlasses as the provisional online-first vertical rather than hard-coded business identity.
requirements.runtime_evidence: Domain profile and generic object/runtime packages exist.
requirements.remaining_gap: A second domain has not been exercised through the full workflow.
requirements.next_action: Use a synthetic no-cost domain portability fixture after the first SmartGlasses vertical slice works.

requirements.requirement: Treat every meaningful entity as an inspectable, versioned, attributable object with lineage and review state.
requirements.runtime_evidence: On 2026-09-14, hosted administrator feedback creation, versioned editing and persistence after reload were exercised. Existing Firestore history was also observed; this does not establish a complete warehouse projection.
requirements.remaining_gap: The full append-only delivery path into BigQuery and all object families have not passed end-to-end acceptance.
requirements.next_action: Exercise idempotent journal-to-warehouse projection and history recovery using a bounded governed fixture.

requirements.requirement: Separate domain ontology from technical dataset metadata and expose concepts, definitions, relationships, constraints, synonyms and proposals.
requirements.runtime_evidence: Semantic routes and ontology-oriented operator views exist locally.
requirements.remaining_gap: The full concept tree, relationship editing, synonym lifecycle and ontology migration impact queue are not proven end to end.
requirements.next_action: Complete metadata-driven ontology tree CRUD and impact-preview objects before autonomous ontology promotion.

requirements.requirement: Preserve temporal validity, recording time, provenance, confidence reasons and correction impact.
requirements.runtime_evidence: Version history and source references exist in local objects.
requirements.remaining_gap: Historical as-of querying and dependent-output invalidation are not proven across cloud projections.
requirements.next_action: Add an as-of semantic query and a revalidation-impact queue backed by versioned change events.

requirements.requirement: Use source-policy and media-rights gates before collection or commercialization, with human tasks only for real uncertainty.
requirements.source: blueprint sections 9 and 23 plus exception-only review steer
requirements.runtime_evidence: Seven source-policy objects exist; all are still pending.
requirements.remaining_gap: No source is currently approved for automated production ingestion.
requirements.next_action: Batch the smallest decision-critical source-policy approvals in the operator inbox.

decision_context.purpose: Historical decision context, not public implementation or current runtime evidence.

requirements.requirement: Use exception-only human review while retaining explicit approval for ontology, source policy, destructive actions and exact publication.
requirements.runtime_evidence: Review routing classifies consequential objects while ordinary local work can proceed without approval.
requirements.remaining_gap: Threshold quality requires operational measurement.
requirements.next_action: Track exception rate and human minutes per accepted output.

decision_context.purpose: Historical decision context, not public implementation or current runtime evidence.

requirements.requirement: Provide one guided solo-operator workspace with tree navigation, search, filters and governed CRUD across ontology, datasets, agents, creative outputs, feedback and publishing.
requirements.runtime_evidence: PR #49 deployed schema-driven operator forms from ef70b13. Chrome exercised canonical enum choices and feedback create/edit/search/reload on 2026-09-14.
requirements.remaining_gap: Equivalent tree CRUD, definitions, impact-aware editing and mobile behavior across every object family remain unaccepted.
requirements.next_action: Exercise ontology, dataset, creative, review and learning stages against the same schema-driven form contract.

requirements.requirement: Require Firebase Google authentication plus a local admin-email allowlist and preserve actor identity for every admin change.
requirements.runtime_evidence: Google sign-in restored the hosted administrator workspace on 2026-09-14. Anonymous administrator requests were rejected; authorized feedback writes persisted with version history.
requirements.remaining_gap: Complete multi-administrator authorization and session-lifecycle acceptance are still required; successful sign-in is not whole-app security acceptance.
requirements.next_action: Exercise permitted and denied administrator identities, sign-out cleanup and session expiry without broadening access.

requirements.requirement: Store structured intelligence and analytics in BigQuery, workflow state in Firestore, artifacts in Cloud Storage and compute in scale-to-zero Cloud Run.
requirements.runtime_evidence: Firebase Hosting, the Cloud Run API and Firestore-backed administrator writes are deployed and exercised. Earlier warehouse creation is recorded, but populated cloud projection and worker execution are not accepted.
requirements.remaining_gap: Durable warehouse projection, media delivery and bounded cloud worker execution still lack complete end-to-end evidence.
requirements.next_action: Complete the existing cloud data/media paths and verify bounded worker receipts; do not create a second stack.

requirements.requirement: Give agents semantic/domain tools rather than arbitrary storage access.
requirements.runtime_evidence: Bounded local semantic read/compare interfaces exist.
requirements.remaining_gap: The MCP server packaging and cloud authorization boundary are not deployed.
requirements.next_action: Expose the existing semantic interface through one authenticated MCP server only when the cloud API is stable.

requirements.requirement: Use one generic bounded agent runtime with task-scoped roles, distilled context, budgets, leases, retries and idempotency.
requirements.runtime_evidence: Local typed tasks and roster-backed roles exist.
requirements.remaining_gap: The Cloud Run runtime, durable queue, lease recovery and production quota enforcement are not active.
requirements.next_action: Deploy one generic worker against Firestore tasks with a zero-paid-call smoke task.

requirements.requirement: Capture every substantive feedback item as a classified learning artifact without allowing silent policy self-modification.
requirements.source: owner feedback and intelligence evolution protocol
requirements.runtime_evidence: Versioned feedback create/edit and persistence after reload were exercised in the deployed operator on 2026-09-14. That is capture evidence, not proof of automatic learning or policy promotion.
requirements.remaining_gap: Continuous feedback synchronization, evaluated agent changes and rollback are not yet an accepted production loop.
requirements.next_action: Run one bounded feedback-to-proposal-to-evaluation cycle and retain versioned receipts before enabling recurring promotion.

decision_context.purpose: Historical decision context, not public implementation or current runtime evidence.

requirements.requirement: Ingest Gmail Google Alerts through the Gmail API, deduplicate news, retain provenance and create time-based industry intelligence.
requirements.runtime_evidence: Gmail API is enabled and a local OAuth token was created; no ingestion run has been recorded.
requirements.remaining_gap: No deduplicated alert/news objects or monthly rollup exist yet.
requirements.next_action: Run a bounded read-only first ingestion and inspect only exceptions.

requirements.requirement: Learn monthly from leading smart-glasses YouTube channels without duplicate capture or unauthorized transcript reuse.
requirements.runtime_evidence: A bounded metadata-only API pipeline now exists with 29-day expiry, current-snapshot deduplication, no media or transcript download and metadata-free long-term receipts.
requirements.remaining_gap: The first live run and recurring scheduler receipt are not yet recorded; signals still require independent evidence before governance promotion.
requirements.next_action: Run the bounded API workflow once, then schedule it every four weeks with failure-only notification.

requirements.requirement: Use a reusable rights-aware media catalog first and generate an image only when no suitable legal asset exists, capped at USD 0.10 per image.
requirements.runtime_evidence: One attributed real product photograph was admitted to the local catalog; same-byte reuse and wrong-product rejection were exercised. The governed schema previously rejected photography; this patch adds typed photograph support but is not deployed backend evidence.
requirements.remaining_gap: Local photographs are not yet integrated into governed cloud media delivery and an exact rights-cleared vertical artifact. Paid fallback remains unexercised and cost-gated.
requirements.next_action: Deploy compatible readers before cloud photograph writes, then connect catalog selection to the governed renderer without relaxing identity, rights or publication gates.

requirements.requirement: Generate energetic original-image and background-music kinetic videos using reusable primitives, not mechanical narration or generic templates.
requirements.source: creative feedback and blueprint sections 17 to 19
requirements.runtime_evidence: Three local render artifacts exist; all remain pending review.
requirements.remaining_gap: Primitive performance attribution, caption QA, visual regression and cloud rendering are incomplete.
requirements.next_action: Promote the liked render through exact review, then bind its primitive usage to the first metric record.

requirements.requirement: Keep each canonical video 9:16 and 30 to 90 seconds, with one primary question or attribute and no more than two products.
requirements.runtime_evidence: Contracts enforce the limits; the atomic composer now represents one concept through several scenes of at most 15 seconds.
requirements.remaining_gap: No newly generated atomic plan has yet completed the entire release flow.
requirements.next_action: Generate the revision-2 package from the approved product and render it through the governed pipeline.

requirements.requirement: Retain one canonical video in the owned app, auto-publish approved exact content to YouTube and LinkedIn, and create manual kits for Instagram, TikTok and X.
requirements.runtime_evidence: Adapters and exact-hash gates exist; no distribution package, publication request, provider receipt or staged canonical video exists yet.
requirements.remaining_gap: Exact artifact approval, current release gates, OAuth scopes, channel eligibility and a public app URL are unproven.
requirements.next_action: Prepare a package only after the chosen render and its source/media policies are approved.

requirements.requirement: Provide a consumer swipe experience with canonical videos, evidence access, comments, questions, likes and dislikes retained in our system.
requirements.runtime_evidence: Local swipe cards and canonical-video feed code exist; no approved canonical video has been staged.
requirements.remaining_gap: Cloud persistence, moderation, abuse controls and production identity are incomplete.
requirements.next_action: Persist public events to Firestore after the first approved video, then add moderation queues only for text.

requirements.requirement: Use APIs and CLIs before browser automation; use computer control only for consent or unsupported platform actions.
requirements.runtime_evidence: Gmail, YouTube and LinkedIn paths are API-based; manual kits replace unsupported posting automation.
requirements.remaining_gap: Provider API access must still be validated at execution time.
requirements.next_action: Retain browser use only for account-holder consent and channel setup.

requirements.requirement: Choose the least costly capable model and deterministic code where judgment is unnecessary.
requirements.runtime_evidence: A local adviser and ledger exist.
requirements.remaining_gap: Recommendations do not enforce actual model selection or provider token budgets.
requirements.next_action: Bind task admission to supported runtime model IDs and measured cost per accepted result.

requirements.requirement: Stay within the cumulative USD 500 experiment ceiling, count the owner-reported USD 80 once, and require explicit approval at financial boundaries.
requirements.runtime_evidence: Budget policy exists and the cloud project has billing enabled; actual provider charges are not reconciled.
requirements.remaining_gap: Provider billing exports and reservations are not connected to one enforced admission ledger.
requirements.next_action: Connect billing export estimates before unattended variable-cost jobs.

requirements.requirement: Maintain security, local-only secrets, least privilege, prompt-injection boundaries, scoped publisher credentials and no secret logging.
requirements.runtime_evidence: Local credential files and scoped API roles exist; previously disclosed long-lived credentials still require provider rotation.
requirements.remaining_gap: Cloud Secret Manager/workload identity and deployed security tests are incomplete.
requirements.next_action: Rotate disclosed credentials, then deploy with workload identity and provider-specific secret access.

requirements.requirement: Separate factual quality from creative popularity and feed time-series channel metrics back to the exact video and primitive recipe.
requirements.runtime_evidence: The owned-app collector now emits rows matching the two provisioned BigQuery analytics tables and binds engagement to versioned recipe primitives without copying comments or session IDs.
requirements.remaining_gap: No canonical video events exist yet, warehouse writes remain disabled, and authorized YouTube/LinkedIn collectors are not implemented.
requirements.next_action: After the first owned video is staged, collect its internal events, add idempotent BigQuery projection, then add authorized YouTube snapshots.

requirements.requirement: Create sustainable revenue potential through useful intelligence, disclosed commercial relationships, paid reports/tools and measured qualified intent rather than views alone.
requirements.runtime_evidence: One commerce assessment and two commerce-path objects exist; no active approved offer, conversion or collected revenue is recorded.
requirements.remaining_gap: No validated merchant/affiliate eligibility, offer page, attribution event or revenue receipt exists.
requirements.next_action: Select one remote, reversible commercial offer after the first useful audience artifact and measure outbound intent before integration spend.

requirements.requirement: Deploy a laptop-independent vertical slice from lawful research through semantic comparison, render, exact approval, publication and metric return.
requirements.runtime_evidence: Hosting, administrator sign-in and versioned feedback CRUD are exercised. A local licensed-photo catalog exists. Approved owned-site video playback, warehouse execution, publishing and commercial receipts are not yet demonstrated end to end.
requirements.remaining_gap: The complete research-to-approved-video-to-feedback operating loop has not passed acceptance.
requirements.next_action: Close media delivery, vertical render, exact approval, owned-channel playback and bounded metric capture before friends-and-family UAT.

requirements.requirement: Create and brand a dedicated project YouTube channel using browser consent only when no supported API can perform account-level channel creation.
requirements.runtime_evidence: YouTube Data API is enabled; no dedicated channel identity or branding receipt is recorded.
requirements.remaining_gap: Channel creation and branding require account-holder browser interaction and final identity choices.
requirements.next_action: Prepare branding assets and perform one bundled account-holder channel setup when the first publishable video is ready.

requirements.requirement: Keep all material feedback and requirements synchronized through a compact traceability authority rather than scattered chat memory.
requirements.runtime_evidence: The registry contains 35 requirements. The 2026-09-14 reconciliation updates only its declared review scope and separates private decision context from public implementation evidence.
requirements.remaining_gap: Several entries retain historical observations; complete runtime evidence and synchronization across affected canonical surfaces remain ongoing.
requirements.next_action: Audit registry structure in CI and reconcile each requirement against commit- and deployment-specific evidence at its acceptance boundary.

requirements.requirement: Maintain four explicit personas: platform custodian, delegated operating executive, business administrator, and audience/customer, with separate authority even when one human fills multiple roles.
requirements.runtime_evidence: The canonical role and reserved-authority matrix is version controlled and referenced by the master instructions.
requirements.remaining_gap: Production actor claims and role enforcement remain dependent on durable cloud identity and persistence.
requirements.next_action: Bind cloud API actor claims to this role vocabulary during Firestore cutover.

requirements.requirement: Use GitHub issues as the sole authoritative post-version-1 change intake and pull requests as the implementation, review, evidence, and release history.
requirements.runtime_evidence: Issue #36 and PR #49 demonstrate authenticated GitHub intake, a bounded branch, successful CI and normal PR merge. Hosting was deployed from the merged commit.
requirements.remaining_gap: Every applicable change still needs its own linked evidence; complete default-branch protection and environment-promotion settings are not re-certified by this observation.
requirements.next_action: Continue issue-linked PRs and validate actual repository/environment protection at the release boundary; do not infer controls from documentation alone.

requirements.requirement: Evaluate a diversified revenue portfolio including advertising, disclosed affiliate relationships, sponsorship, reports/tools, data/API access, customer-funded video, licensing, education, and potential asset sale.
requirements.runtime_evidence: Revenue candidates and measurement rules are versioned as hypotheses.
requirements.remaining_gap: No channel has verified collected revenue or validated unit economics.
requirements.next_action: Test one low-cost offer after the first useful approved audience release and record contribution rather than views alone.

requirements.requirement: Retain canonical media in owned storage and treat social platforms as distribution channels so a platform suspension does not erase the core media asset.
requirements.runtime_evidence: Owned staging is part of the canonical distribution contract.
requirements.remaining_gap: No approved canonical video is stored in production Cloud Storage or served from Firebase Hosting.
requirements.next_action: Stage the first rights-cleared approved video in owned storage before platform publication.

requirements.requirement: Continuously improve the ontology through stable concepts, deterministic shapes, provenance, dataset versioning, rights policies, impact analysis, and evaluated migrations without requiring a graph database in version 1.
requirements.runtime_evidence: SKOS, SHACL, PROV-O, DCAT, ODRL and JSON-LD alignment is specified against W3C primary sources; existing version and lineage primitives implement part of the profile.
requirements.remaining_gap: Mappings, shape reports, rights-policy serialization and JSON-LD/DCAT exports are not runtime-complete.
requirements.next_action: Implement stable concept mappings and immutable shape-validation reports before a second live domain.

requirements.requirement: Offer customer-funded 30 to 90 second generation only after measuring all direct costs, rights, abuse, quality, payment, refund, and support risks, with a provisional 30 percent gross-margin target.
requirements.runtime_evidence: The opportunity and gates are documented; no customer, billing, tenancy, abuse, or job-cost system exists.
requirements.remaining_gap: This is deliberately outside the first single-domain production slice.
requirements.next_action: Validate demand with a manually priced paid pilot only after the owned release workflow and actual unit cost are proven.

requirements.requirement: Freeze version 1 as a reproducible, truthfully labeled release candidate with complete structure, documentation, security policy, machine-readable architecture, and automated readiness evidence.
requirements.runtime_evidence: PR #49 CI passed, its merged ef70b13 Hosting release was deployed, and 242 Python tests, 66 JavaScript tests and 23 hosted checks passed for that release. Chrome exercised sign-in and feedback CRUD.
requirements.remaining_gap: These are scoped release checks, not complete production acceptance. Media, audience workflow, warehouse execution, recovery and reconciled cost admission remain open.
requirements.next_action: Retain exact-artifact evidence for each remaining gate and declare friends-and-family readiness only after the complete workflow passes.

review_scope.limitation: Targeted reconciliation only. Other entries retain their earlier observation baseline; this date does not certify every integration or friends-and-family readiness.
